objective_text: the mean cross-entropy of the mapped distribution against the item's HUMAN distribution (target_probs), over the items that carry one
split_rule: 5-fold cross-validation, stratified by type: every type's items are sorted by id, shuffled with random.Random(seed) and dealt round-robin into the five folds (temperature.stratified_folds, the temperature fit's own function); a fold's (T, b) is fitted on the other four folds' items of the type that carry a human distribution, and applied to the fold's own items.

verdict.note: (c) is a population-level guard: the Capability of the arm made of the types that pass (a) and (b). A type that passes (a)/(b) but whose addition costs the 235 its Capability does not ship. The noul is judged separately: if the set fails (c), it is removed first and (c) is re-checked for the others, and its own 235 competence must hold (§20.2).

source.dataset: Praveenrajus/jev-bench, the validation split, the 500-per-type pool of soft_label_pool.json (seed 20261021)
source.arm: the serial first-token path, one question per request, the server at T = 1, a fresh engine (6306 s, 1500/1500, 0 failures)
source.note: the pool is licence-clean and out of sample with respect to OpenDecisions and to the jev-bench test split; the map is fitted on it and on nothing else
